name: components-backgrounds-stars
blurb: Three-layer starfield that parallaxes toward the pointer.
description: Creates stars via box-shadow in three layers with different sizes and scroll speeds. The entire field shifts based on pointer position using a spring animation for smooth parallax.
use_when: A space-like background that responds subtly to pointer movement, adding depth without overwhelming the page.
avoid_when: Touch-only devices — parallax relies on pointer tracking and does nothing on touch. Continuous animation may impact performance on weaker devices.
a11y: Passive background wrapper; focus and keyboard behaviour come from children. Parallax animation has no prefers-reduced-motion guard.
